title: Asking the way
subtitle: 길 묻기
review: Written by Claude. The Korean and the romanization have not been checked by a Korean speaker. The Burmese explanations are drafts by Claude: check them. Check before recording audio.

categories.desc: Finding a place, and finding out where you are.
cards: Hwajangsiri eodiyeyo?
Where is the toilet?

화장실이 어디예요?

A place + -i or -ga eodiyeyo?: where is…?

Jeogiyo, jihacheollyeogi eodiyeyo?
저기요, 지하철역이 어디예요?
Excuse me, where is the subway station?

my: အိမ်သာ ဘယ်မှာလဲ။

화장실이 어디예요?

နေရာ + -i ဒါမှမဟုတ် -ga eodiyeyo?: …ဘယ်မှာလဲ။
တဆိတ်လောက်၊ မြေအောက်ရထားဘူတာ ဘယ်မှာလဲ။

cards: I geuncheoe pyeonuijeom isseoyo?
Is there a convenience store near here?

이 근처에 편의점 있어요?

I geuncheoe: near here.

I geuncheoe eunhaeng isseoyo?
이 근처에 은행 있어요?
Is there a bank near here?

my:
이 근처에 편의점 있어요?

I geuncheoe: ဒီနားမှာ။

cards: Yeogiga eodiyeyo?
Where am I?

여기가 어디예요?

'Where is here?' Show your map as you ask.

Jeogiyo, yeogiga eodiyeyo? Gireul ireosseoyo.
저기요, 여기가 어디예요? 길을 잃었어요.
Excuse me, where am I? I'm lost.

my: ဒီနေရာက ဘယ်နေရာလဲ။

여기가 어디예요?

'ဒီနေရာက ဘယ်နေရာလဲ' လို့ အဓိပ္ပာယ်ရတယ်။ မေးရင်း မြေပုံကို ပြပါ။
တဆိတ်လောက်၊ ဒီနေရာက ဘယ်နေရာလဲ။ လမ်းပျောက်နေလို့ပါ။

cards: Meoreoyo?
Is it far?

멀어요?

Near: gakkawoyo.

Yeogiseo meoreoyo? — Anieyo, georeoseo o bunieyo.
여기서 멀어요? — 아니에요, 걸어서 오 분이에요.
Is it far from here? — No, five minutes on foot.

my:
멀어요?

နီးတယ်: gakkawoyo။
ဒီကနေ ဝေးလား။ — မဝေးပါဘူး၊ ခြေလျင် ငါးမိနစ်ပါ။

categories.desc: The four things you are most likely to be told.
cards: Jjuk gaseyo.
Go straight ahead.

쭉 가세요.

Also: Ttokbaro gaseyo.

I gillo jjuk gaseyo.
이 길로 쭉 가세요.
Go straight along this street.

my: တည့်တည့်သွားပါ။

쭉 가세요.

Ttokbaro gaseyo လို့လည်း ပြောနိုင်တယ်။
ဒီလမ်းအတိုင်း တည့်တည့်သွားပါ။

cards: Oreunjjogeuro gaseyo.
Go right.

오른쪽으로 가세요.

Left: oenjjok.

Daeum sageorieseo oenjjogeuro gaseyo.
다음 사거리에서 왼쪽으로 가세요.
Go left at the next crossroads.

my: ညာဘက် သွားပါ။

오른쪽으로 가세요.

ဘယ်ဘက်: oenjjok။
နောက်လမ်းဆုံမှာ ဘယ်ဘက် သွားပါ။

cards: Hoengdanbodoreul geonneoseyo.
Cross at the crossing.

횡단보도를 건너세요.

Hoengdanbodo: pedestrian crossing.

Jeo hoengdanbodoreul geonneoseyo.
저 횡단보도를 건너세요.
Cross at that crossing.

my:
횡단보도를 건너세요.

Hoengdanbodo: လူကူးမျဉ်းကြား။

cards: Baro jeogiyeyo.
It's right there.

바로 저기예요.

Baro: right, just.

Ucheguk baro jeogiyeyo. Eunhaeng yeopieyo.
우체국 바로 저기예요. 은행 옆이에요.
The post office is right there. It's next to the bank.

my:
바로 저기예요.

Baro: တည့်တည့်၊ ချက်ချင်း။
စာတိုက်က ဟိုနားလေးမှာပါ။ ဘဏ်ဘေးမှာ ရှိတယ်။

tr.my: လမ်းညွှန်တာကို နားလည်ခြင်း

categories.desc: The right train, a ticket, and a taxi.
cards: I jihacheol Gangnam gayo?
Does this train go to Gangnam?

이 지하철 강남 가요?

Ask before you get on.

I beoseu gonghang gayo?
이 버스 공항 가요?
Does this bus go to the airport?

my: ဒီရထား ဂန်နမ်ကို သွားလား။

이 지하철 강남 가요?

မတက်ခင် မေးပါ။
ဒီဘတ်စ်ကား လေဆိပ်ကို သွားလား။

cards: Pyo eodiseo sayo?
Where do I buy a ticket?

표 어디서 사요?

Pyo: ticket.

Jeogiyo, pyo eodiseo sayo? — Jeogiyeyo.
저기요, 표 어디서 사요? — 저기예요.
Excuse me, where do I buy a ticket? — Over there.

my: လက်မှတ် ဘယ်မှာ ဝယ်ရလဲ။

표 어디서 사요?

Pyo: လက်မှတ်။
တဆိတ်လောက်၊ လက်မှတ် ဘယ်မှာ ဝယ်ရလဲ။ — ဟိုဘက်မှာပါ။

cards: Daeum yeogi eodiyeyo?
What is the next station?

다음 역이 어디예요?

Daeum: next. Yeok: station.

Daeum yeogi eodiyeyo? — Sicheongieyo.
다음 역이 어디예요? — 시청이에요.
What is the next station? — City Hall.

my: နောက်ဘူတာက ဘာဘူတာလဲ။

다음 역이 어디예요?

Daeum: နောက်တစ်ခု။ Yeok: ဘူတာ။
နောက်ဘူတာက ဘာဘူတာလဲ။ — မြို့တော်ခန်းမ ဘူတာပါ။

cards: Yeogiro ga juseyo.
To this place, please.

여기로 가 주세요.

In a taxi: show the address on your phone.

I jusoro ga juseyo.
이 주소로 가 주세요.
To this address, please.

my:
여기로 가 주세요.

တက္ကစီပေါ်မှာ ဖုန်းထဲက လိပ်စာကို ပြပါ။

tr.my: မြေအောက်ရထားနှင့် တက္ကစီ
